author: John Khan

face_set.manifest_policy: Exact SHA-256 image-content hashes frozen in advance. No training, tuning or data duplication.

metric: Local on-device cosmetic overlay must preserve source photo and untouched areas and present an accurate visual simulation label; any provider-assisted preview is recorded separately and requires consent.

test_protocol.source: Frozen photo input remains private; local preview only in 10k run. No provider calls or image uploads.
test_protocol.comparison: Compare originals and local previews using independently reviewed masks and conservative alpha boundaries; exclude no slices.
test_protocol.reference: Independent human review of obvious artefacts plus pixel-difference checks. Masks may not be derived from protected ground-truth labels.
test_protocol.provider: Mock-only provider boundary unit tests; live YouCam quality on 10k faces is NOT measured by this definition and cannot be claimed.

notes: Every edited region requires independently provisioned mask evidence; if missing, UNPROVEN.
This is a preregistered test specification, not a result or release approval.
